prep.transcript: A. Girard: Let's start with the P&ID rev D. C. Morvan: The I/O list still consumes rev C — three tags are missing in the PLC table, TT-104, PT-108 and the new ZS-112. Girard: On inconsistencies C-04 and C-05, we agree to close C-04 as a drawing error and keep C-05 open until the supplier confirms the status word mapping. P. Noguès: I will send the corrected P&ID sheet for C-04 by 3 October. C. Morvan: For the client question on the HV cell date, electrical can confirm we need the cell energised by 20 November at the latest — that is the answer to give the port authority. A. Girard: Noted, we will carry it to the steering committee.
